home.title: Ethereal Space
home.subtitle: Creating meaningful digital experiences through structural honesty and vast negative space.
home.minimalismText: We believe in the power of less. By stripping away the non-essential, we allow the true character of your content to breathe.
home.precisionText: Meticulous attention to typography and layout ensures every pixel serves a purpose in the digital landscape.
home.clarityText: Visual hierarchy isn't just about size—it's about guidance. We create paths that lead users naturally through information.
home.quote: Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works.

about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Redefining digital experiences through the lens of intentionality and essentialism.
about.p1: At Alabaster Zen, we believe that the most powerful solutions are often the simplest ones. In an era of digital noise and constant distraction, we choose to speak through silence and space.
about.p2: Our journey began with a simple observation: modern software often obscures utility with unnecessary complexity. We set out to strip away the vanity, leaving behind only the essential core.
about.p3: We treat every interface like a gallery wall. Every element must earn its place. If it doesn't serve a purpose, it is gracefully removed.
about.coreTenetsSubtitle: The principles that guide every pixel we place and every line of code we write.
about.spaceText: Negative space is not empty; it is a structural element that provides breathing room for the mind.
about.honestyText: We never hide. Buttons look like buttons, and hierarchy is communicated through natural light and shadow.
about.harmonyText: Our palettes are inspired by natural stone, light, and paper. Calm, sophisticated, and enduring.
